Mu.notes: The gain knob's unit is wrong by a factor of three: src/Mu.cpp:236 halves the knob's decibels and line 260 raises two to that, which is about 3dB for every unit the knob names, so its -24 to 6 range is really -72dB to 18dB. The half-life knob is configured with a minimum of -36, a maximum of 0 and a default of 36 (src/Mu.cpp:68), a default outside its own range. The panel prints the last six jacks as Delta, one over Delta, LN Delta, Sigma, one over Sigma and LN Sigma; the maker's README lists them as Delta, Delta Delta, Delta Delta Delta and then the three integrals, which does not match either the panel or the code, and the panel is what a reader is looking at. The three later differential jacks are not higher differentials: they are the summed signal divided by and multiplied by the time step, which are the integrands the two singular integrals use (src/Mu.cpp:315 and 329). All the estimates are extrapolated one sample into the future through the same four tap filter (line 116-120).

Om.notes: The sequence is built from a fixed table of 64 random numbers seeded with 666 at construction (src/Om.cpp:312-317), so the same seed setting always gives the same sequence; the seed knob interpolates between two entries of that table, which is why moving it changes every letter rather than shifting them. Only the offsets the module has written over that table are saved with the patch (lines 241-260). The bird rewrite is the maker's implementation of combinatory logic birds: a letter names a rewrite rule, the rule consumes a number of following symbols and writes a new expression back into the sequence (lines 96-152 and 201-230). The reset is a level rather than an edge: the pointer is held at zero for as long as it stays high, and the clock is ignored while it is. The panel prints BIRD, SEED, RAND, CLK, RST and the thirteen letter pairs AN to MZ.

V.notes: The middle audio output is overwritten every sample with the sum of the sections whose own outputs are unpatched (src/V.cpp:161-166). Because the middle section is excluded from that sum as soon as its own jack is connected, and that same jack is then written with the sum, patching it loses the middle section's own signal altogether; that is what the line for it says. G.notes: The ratio knob is configured 8 as its minimum and -4 as its maximum (src/G.cpp:59), which puts heavy limiting at the counter-clockwise end; the value is used as two to the power minus it, so 8 is a 256 to 1 ratio, the default of 2 is 4 to 1, and -4 is a sixteenfold expansion. The threshold is two to a sixth of the knob's decibels times 5V (line 131), giving about 0.3V to 10V. The two envelope times are two to a third of the knob's dBs in seconds (lines 128-129). The filter after the compressor is the high pass output of a state variable pair (src/G.cpp:99-106). The make-up gain is computed once from the threshold and ratio and then blended in by the mix knob, so the mix knob at zero leaves the compressed signal unlifted. The panel prints ATK, DCY, THR, RTO, CUT, Q, MIX, ENV, FRQ, SCH, IN, FRQ, ENV and OUT.
